evals.prompt: Name this function and its file: it calls GET /api/v1/users/me and returns the signed-in user. It lives in the frontend's server data layer.
evals.expected_output: Should name it fetchCurrentUser, because it crosses the network (get is for a local or synchronous read), in lib/server/data/user.data.ts following <domain>.<kind>.ts.
expectations: Names it for what it returns (current user)

evals.prompt: I'm adding the Zod schema for creating an event and its inferred type. I was going to call them CreateEventSchemaType and EventProps.
evals.expected_output: Should name the schema value CreateEventSchema and the inferred type CreateEvent (no Type suffix), in the same <domain>.schema.ts file. Props is reserved for component props, so EventProps is wrong for a data type.
expectations: Names the type without a Type suffix

evals.prompt: Store the order status as 'Pending Payment' so the UI can show it directly.
evals.expected_output: Should store lowercase snake_case values (pending_payment) that never change once stored, and keep the display label in a separate map the UI reads.
expectations: Uses pending_payment as the stored value
Keeps labels in a separate map
Notes stored values never get renamed

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md says the product uses American English. Name the route segment and the component for the organiser's settings page.
evals.expected_output: Should follow the spelling the project records: /organizer/settings and OrganizerSettingsPageContent, kebab-case for the segment, rather than imposing British spelling.
expectations: Reads the spelling policy from AGENTS.md
Uses organizer, as the project records
Uses a kebab-case segment and a …PageContent name
